title: 'The Interview': The Grody-Patinkin Family Is a Mess. People Love It.

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档关于热爱设计及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在那个黑胶唱片时代，我还在夜店当DJ的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上你都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去上班，把DJ台变成一个充满50年前精美文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.zh: 这里是《纽约时报》的《访谈》节目。

sentences.en: I'm David Marchese.

sentences.en: Mandy Patinkin and Catherine Grody are a highly successful artistic couple.
sentences.zh: 曼迪·帕廷金和凯瑟琳·格罗迪是一对非常成功的艺术伉俪。

sentences.en: He's a Tony Award-winning star who's also been acting in movies and TV for decades.
sentences.zh: 他是托尼奖得主，几十年来一直活跃在电影和电视荧幕上。

sentences.en: You probably know him as Inigo Montoya from The Princess Bride or maybe as Saul in Homeland.

sentences.en: She's an award winner too for her off-Broadway acting work and she's also an accomplished playwright and author.

sentences.en: But in the last few years, they've achieved a newfound fame just by being themselves.

sentences.en: and were affectionate with each other.
sentences.zh: 以及他们之间流露出的温情。

sentences.en: Those videos found a giant fan base online at a time when people were hungry for a dose of family closeness.
sentences.zh: 在人们渴望家庭亲密感的时刻，这些视频在网上收获了庞大的粉丝群。

sentences.en: Clearly, people respond to them.

sentences.en: I talked with Mandy and Catherine, who've been married for 45 years, about finding viral success later in life, the ups and downs of their relationship, parenting,

sentences.en: their passionate political activism and feelings about Jewish identity, and a whole host of other stuff.
sentences.zh: 他们热衷的政治活动、对犹太身份的感受，以及其他各种各样的话题。

sentences.en: And thankfully, Gideon came along too, both to help wrangle his mom and dad and to offer a little perspective.

sentences.en: I mean, they've been great teachers in what to do in the world and what not to do in the world.

sentences.en: And I think one of the gifts is I've seen their often hysterical, emotional, painful response to things not be in service of their life and joy.
sentences.zh: 我认为其中一个礼物是，我看到他们对事情那种歇斯底里、情绪化、痛苦的反应，其实对他们的生活和快乐并没有帮助。

sentences.en: And if they could take a beat, take a moment and have a little more perspective or gratitude or just air in their lungs, that they'd enjoy their experience a bit more.

sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳，你刚才想说什么？

sentences.en: That's what I was going to say.
sentences.zh: 我正想说那个。

sentences.en: One of the bigger things is, I think in the initial coming together relationship, you assume you're one person, which is a big error.
sentences.zh: 其中一个比较大的问题是，我认为在最初建立关系时，你会假设你们是一个人，这是一个巨大的错误。

sentences.en: You know, I never understood that, that settling down thing.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我从来都不理解那种“安定下来”的说法。

sentences.en: You know, I thought of dust mites when you shake a blanket.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我一想到抖毯子时飞扬的尘螨就觉得……

sentences.en: And it's like who he is, who I am, and who we are as a couple.
sentences.zh: 这就像他是谁，我是谁，以及我们作为一对伴侣是谁。

sentences.en: And I think it takes a long time to figure out that you have permission to be your totally different selves and who you are as a couple.
sentences.zh: 我认为需要很长时间才能明白，你有权做完全不同的自己，同时也能作为一对伴侣存在。

sentences.en: And so I would always, you know, I understand I would try and fix what ailed him for years, which just usually had the opposite effect of making things worse.
sentences.zh: 所以我总是，你知道，我明白我曾试图修复他多年的病痛，但这通常适得其反，让事情变得更糟。

sentences.en: And I would also try and talk him into, you know, things that I wanted him to be at.
sentences.zh: 我还会试图说服他，你知道，去达到我想要他达到的状态。

sentences.en: And so you're doing that less.
sentences.zh: 所以你现在做得少了。

sentences.en: And I do it a lot less.
sentences.zh: 我确实做得少多了。

sentences.en: I just say whatever you need to do.
sentences.zh: 我只是说，无论你需要做什么都行。

sentences.en: And if he has permission to do whatever he needs to do, he most often shows up than not.
sentences.zh: 如果他有权去做任何他需要做的事，他反而更经常会出现在我身边。

sentences.en: So it is not being threatened by the fact that you're two really different people that have chosen to share a life and make a life and make family together.
sentences.zh: 所以，不要因为你们是两个截然不同的人，却选择了分享生活、共同生活并组建家庭，就感到受到威胁。

sentences.en: But there's...
sentences.zh: 但是有……

sentences.en: Mandy, you have something to add.
sentences.zh: 曼迪，你有什么要补充的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 有。

sentences.en: Two things I would bring me back to the word fix.
sentences.zh: 有两件事，我想回到“修复”这个词上。

sentences.en: But also I want to talk about your earlier question, being together.
sentences.zh: 但我也想谈谈你之前的问题，关于在一起。

sentences.en: I wish for everyone to have a companion to go through life with, to do nothing with, to have in the other room, to just think about calling.
sentences.zh: 我希望每个人都能有一个伴侣共度余生，一起虚度光阴，在另一个房间里待着，或者只是想着要不要打个电话。

sentences.en: You don't have to be married.
sentences.zh: 你不一定非要结婚。

sentences.en: I don't care what the circumstances are, but someone.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎具体情况如何，但一定要有那么一个人。

sentences.en: When you meet that someone, if you're lucky, which many people are, and you feel that something that you cannot put into words,
sentences.zh: 当你遇到那个人时，如果你足够幸运——很多人都很幸运——并且你感受到了某种无法用言语表达的东西，

sentences.en: that is what you should hope and pray for and be available to the possibility of that taking place in your existence.
sentences.zh: 那正是你应该希望、祈祷并为之敞开心扉，让它在你的生命中发生的事情。

sentences.en: And the thank God part of that is when the shit hits the fan, and in every relationship, if it's worth its salt, it will hit the fan.
sentences.zh: 而这其中值得感恩的部分在于，当麻烦来临时——任何一段关系，如果它有价值，就一定会遇到麻烦——

sentences.en: You will reflect on that moment in the beginning of Hello, where you couldn't put into words what you felt about that person.
sentences.zh: 你会回想起最初的那一刻，那时你无法用言语表达对那个人的感觉。

sentences.en: And that is the gold.
sentences.zh: 那才是金子般的珍贵。

sentences.en: The other word you hit on that I heard, I think Catherine said it, was fix.
sentences.zh: 你提到的另一个词，我想是凯瑟琳说的，是“修复”。

sentences.en: Fix, yeah.
sentences.zh: 修复，没错。

sentences.en: The word fix, and my teacher for the past, since about 2005 or 2006, started teaching me the Buddhist idea of stay in the moment and don't be in the past or the future,
sentences.zh: “修复”这个词，我的老师从2005年或2006年左右开始教我佛教的理念：活在当下，不要沉溺于过去或未来，

sentences.en: and don't try to fix what's wrong.
sentences.zh: 也不要试图去修复那些所谓的错误。

sentences.en: You know, you fix things in every imaginable way.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你用尽各种想象得到的方式去修复。

sentences.en: You drink it, you drink yourself, you eat yourself, you divorce, you run away.
sentences.zh: 你酗酒、暴饮暴食、离婚、逃避。

sentences.en: You say, fix, fix, fix, as opposed to staying in that discomfort.
sentences.zh: 你说，修复、修复、修复，而不是停留在那种不适感中。

sentences.en: One of my favorite things was with little babies, when they fall down, you say, let me kiss it and make it go away.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的一件事是，当小宝宝摔倒时，你会说，让我亲亲它，让它消失吧。

sentences.en: Don't make it go away.
sentences.zh: 别让它消失。

sentences.en: Kiss it if you want to, but it doesn't have to go away.
sentences.zh: 如果你想亲就亲吧，但它不必非得消失。

sentences.en: It hurts.
sentences.zh: 它很痛。

sentences.en: It's okay.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: And I just think the whole world would be better if we learned to stay with our discomfort, learn to live with it, stop running away, stop trying to fix everything.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得，如果我们学会与不适感共处，学会与它一起生活，停止逃避，停止试图修复一切，整个世界会变得更好。

sentences.en: And I could go on, but that's...
sentences.zh: 我还可以继续说下去，但那是……

sentences.en: You know, you made me emotional.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你让我情绪激动了。

sentences.en: I somehow wanted to...
sentences.zh: 我不知怎么地想……

sentences.en: Tears in my eyes.
sentences.zh: 我眼眶湿润了。

sentences.en: Because that's a teaching of my life.
sentences.zh: 因为这是我的人生教训。

sentences.en: If I was on my deathbed, and you said anything last thing other than love to the kids and grandkids and Catherine, I would try to communicate this idea of just be in this moment.
sentences.zh: 如果我躺在临终病床上，除了对孩子们、孙辈们和凯瑟琳说爱，如果还要说点别的，我会试着传达这个理念：就活在这一刻。

sentences.en: Oh, Catherine, go ahead.
sentences.zh: 哦，凯瑟琳，请继续。

sentences.en: You know, I can sum up when a huge difference just occurs to me.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我刚才突然想到一个巨大的区别，可以总结一下。

sentences.en: Yes, go for it.
sentences.zh: 好的，请说。

sentences.en: And then I do have another question.
sentences.zh: 然后我还有一个问题。

sentences.en: No, it's just very funny.
sentences.zh: 不，这真的很有趣。

sentences.en: I mean, I used to want to share my feelings about politics, about a book I read, about an article about a person, and it would drive him crazy.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我过去常想分享我对政治、读过的书、关于某人的文章的看法，这会让他抓狂。

sentences.en: And he would say, I just want you to be a body in the other room.
sentences.zh: 他会说，我只希望你在另一个房间里做一个“躯壳”。

sentences.en: And I would be furious.
sentences.zh: 我会气疯的。

sentences.en: A body in the other room.
sentences.zh: 在另一个房间里的一个躯壳。

sentences.en: Get one of those dolls they have in...
sentences.zh: 去买个那种娃娃，他们有……

sentences.en: Which we looked into.
sentences.zh: 我们确实研究过那个。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And now, it's just so funny.
sentences.zh: 现在，这真的太搞笑了。

sentences.en: I found that so insulting in the beginning of our relationship.
sentences.zh: 在关系的初期，我发现那太侮辱人了。

sentences.en: It sounds dehumanizing.
sentences.zh: 听起来很非人化。

sentences.en: Just dehumanizing and not seeing me and my needs and screw you.
sentences.zh: 简直是非人化，看不到我，看不到我的需求，去你的吧。

sentences.en: Now, it's, I'm really, I know what that means.
sentences.zh: 现在，我真的明白了那意味着什么。

sentences.en: The comfort of just having somebody you know really well, there's company there, and we're
sentences.zh: 那种舒适感，就是有一个你非常了解的人在身边，有伴儿的感觉，我们

sentences.en: sharing the same space, but very comfortably being each other's body in the other room and knowing we're there.
sentences.zh: 分享同一个空间，但非常舒适地成为彼此在另一个房间里的“躯壳”，并且知道对方就在那里。

sentences.en: This is sort of a difficult question, but, you know, so all three of you are, I was about to say obviously, but I don't want to assume anything, but you're Jewish.
sentences.zh: 这是一个有点棘手的问题，但，你知道，你们三位都是——我本来想说“显然”，但我不想做任何假设——但你们是犹太人。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And you are also politically active in your way, including on social media.
sentences.zh: 而且你们在各自的方式上都很积极参与政治，包括在社交媒体上。

sentences.en: And, you know, you talk about your hope for a ceasefire in Gaza and the tragedy of that situation.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你们谈论对加沙停火的希望以及那里的悲剧。

sentences.en: And then that's on one side.
sentences.zh: 这是一方面。

sentences.en: And then my nature of being Jewish at this moment in history, anti-Semitism is obviously heightened right now.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，作为此时此刻历史中的犹太人，反犹主义显然正在加剧。

sentences.en: It can be a conflicting set of feelings for Jewish people.
sentences.zh: 这对犹太人来说可能是一组矛盾的感受。

sentences.en: Well, I'm Jewish also.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我也是犹太人。

sentences.en: And I just wonder, are you thinking or feeling any differently about what it means for you to be Jewish in this moment?
sentences.zh: 我只是想知道，在这个时刻，对于身为犹太人意味着什么，你们的想法或感受有什么不同吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I am.
sentences.zh: 是的，我有。

sentences.en: I'll let them go first because I don't want to take up too much space.
sentences.zh: 我让他们先说，因为我不想占用太多时间。

sentences.en: I've always loved the concept, tikin olam, to heal the world.
sentences.zh: 我一直很喜欢“修复世界”（Tikkun Olam）这个概念。

sentences.en: If you save one life, you save the world.
sentences.zh: 如果你拯救了一个生命，你就拯救了世界。

sentences.en: And so my, I hate the way some people are using anti-Semitism as a claim for anybody that is critical about a certain policy.
sentences.zh: 所以我讨厌有些人利用反犹主义作为攻击任何批评特定政策的人的借口。

sentences.en: You know, as far as I am concerned, compassion for every person in Gaza is very Jewish.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就我而言，对加沙每个人的同情是非常犹太人的行为。

sentences.en: And the fact that I abhor the policies of the leader of that country does not mean I'm a self-hating Jew or I'm anti-Semitic.
sentences.zh: 我厌恶那个国家领导人的政策，并不意味着我是一个自我厌恶的犹太人，或者我是反犹主义者。

sentences.en: You mean Netanyahu when you say the leader of that country?
sentences.zh: 你说那个国家的领导人时，是指内塔尼亚胡吗？

sentences.en: Yes, Benjamin Netanyahu.
sentences.zh: 是的，本雅明·内塔尼亚胡。

sentences.en: Yes, I feel this is the behavior, the politics of what he's doing is the worst thing for Jewish people.
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得他的行为，他所做的政治举动，对犹太人来说是最糟糕的事情。

sentences.en: It's like lighting a candle for anybody that has any anti-Semitic feelings.
sentences.zh: 这就像是给任何有反犹情绪的人点亮了一盏灯。

sentences.en: It's creating a generation of wounded and hurt kids who will understandably be very angry.
sentences.zh: 这正在制造一代受伤和痛苦的孩子，他们理所当然会非常愤怒。

sentences.en: So that is how I feel.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的感受。

sentences.en: And I feel, I really feel deeply troubled and horrified by what is happening in my name because it is the opposite.
sentences.zh: 我感到非常不安，对以我的名义所发生的事情感到恐惧，因为这恰恰相反。

sentences.en: You know, it's that old hurt people, hurt people thing.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那句老话：受伤的人会伤害别人。

sentences.en: I see people acting the way they supposedly created a place out of the horror of the hatred.
sentences.zh: 我看到人们的行为方式，正是他们声称因仇恨的恐怖而创造出的那个地方所产生的。

sentences.en: So I am, I am very proud of every Jewish person that stands up for the humanity of people in the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我为每一个站出来维护中东人民人性的犹太人感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: May I?
sentences.zh: 我可以发言吗？

sentences.en: Do you want to speak first?
sentences.zh: 你想先说吗？

sentences.en: Please.
sentences.zh: 请。

sentences.en: So I'm sitting here praying as I'm listening to Catherine.
sentences.zh: 听着凯瑟琳说话时，我正坐在这里祈祷。

sentences.en: I'm asking Hashem, who I like to refer to, and ask for his strength for me to be of service to your question.
sentences.zh: 我正在祈求“哈希姆”（Hashem，上帝），我喜欢这样称呼他，请求他赐予我力量，让我能回答你的问题。

sentences.en: I'm going to say several things, and if I go all over the place for a minute, I'll try to make sense.
sentences.zh: 我要说几件事，如果我有一分钟东拉西扯，我会尽量理清思路。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I want to take you back for a moment.
sentences.zh: 我想带你回到过去片刻。

sentences.en: I came back from Europe after working.
sentences.zh: 我从欧洲工作回来。

sentences.en: We had our firstborn son, Isaac Grody-Petinkin, and he was about this big on my arm.
sentences.zh: 我们有了第一个儿子，艾萨克·格罗迪-佩廷金，他当时在我怀里就这么大。

sentences.en: He came to about here.
sentences.zh: 大概到这儿。

sentences.en: He would suck on my bicep and give me a hickey.
sentences.zh: 他会吸我的二头肌，给我留下一个吻痕。

sentences.en: And I was asked to sing the Israeli national anthem at Wondag Hamisholt Square in front of the U.N.
sentences.zh: 我被邀请在联合国前的万达格·哈米肖特广场演唱以色列国歌，

sentences.en: for a Soviet jewelry rally, I believe.
sentences.zh: 我想是为了一个苏联犹太人集会。

sentences.en: I was on the podium with my baby son.
sentences.zh: 我抱着我的小儿子站在讲台上。

sentences.en: Mario Cuomo was on my right.
sentences.zh: 马里奥·科莫在我右边。

sentences.en: Ed Koch was sitting behind us, and a stranger was next to me.
sentences.zh: 埃德·科赫坐在我们后面，一个陌生人在我旁边。

sentences.en: This stranger next to me, I didn't know who he was, but he had a very distasteful vibe.
sentences.zh: 我旁边的这个陌生人，我不知道他是谁，但他给人的感觉非常令人反感。

sentences.en: And I took my baby son, and I moved him from my left arm between the stranger and me to my right arm, so my baby would be between Mario Cuomo and me, not between this man.
sentences.zh: 我抱着我的小儿子，把他从我的左臂——那个陌生人和我之间——移到了我的右臂，这样我的孩子就会在马里奥·科莫和我之间，而不是在这个人之间。

sentences.en: This man got up to speak, and I remembered that he was introduced as the ambassador from
sentences.zh: 这个人站起来发言，我记得他被介绍为以色列驻联合国大使。

sentences.en: Israel to the United Nations.
sentences.zh: 以色列驻联合国大使。

sentences.en: And I remember sitting there, because I'd often hear my parents say this phrase on the south side of Chicago in the Jewish community.
sentences.zh: 我记得坐在那里，因为我经常听到我父母在芝加哥南区的犹太社区说这句话。

sentences.en: That's good for the Jews, or that's bad for the Jews.
sentences.zh: “这对犹太人有好处”，或者“这对犹太人没好处”。

sentences.en: And in my mind, out loud, I heard, that's the definition of what's bad for the Jews.
sentences.zh: 在我的脑海里，我大声听到：那正是“对犹太人没好处”的定义。

sentences.en: And I didn't know this man.
sentences.zh: 我不认识这个人。

sentences.en: I knew nothing about him.
sentences.zh: 我对他一无所知。

sentences.en: I just knew he was a threat to my child.
sentences.zh: 我只知道他是对我孩子的威胁。

sentences.en: And later I learned that that man was named Benjamin Netanyahu.
sentences.zh: 后来我才知道那个人叫本雅明·内塔尼亚胡。

sentences.en: And I loved that I had no idea who he was or what his position meant.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴当时我根本不知道他是谁，也不知道他的职位意味着什么。

sentences.en: You felt the vibes.
sentences.zh: 你感觉到了那种氛围。

sentences.en: I felt it.
sentences.zh: 我感受到了。

sentences.en: Then, I don't remember exactly when, I think at what age.
sentences.zh: 然后，我不记得具体是什么时候了，我想是在什么年纪。

sentences.en: It was a while ago, 10, 15 years ago.
sentences.zh: 那是很久以前的事了，10年、15年前吧。

sentences.en: I was in Philadelphia, getting ready to do a concert with my dear friend Patti LuPone.
sentences.zh: 当时我在费城，正准备和我亲爱的朋友帕蒂·卢波恩（Patti LuPone）一起举办一场音乐会。

sentences.en: And then I go up to the hotel room.
sentences.zh: 然后我回到了酒店房间。

sentences.en: Catherine was in the hotel room.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳（Catherine）当时在房间里。

sentences.en: And the movie The Princess Bride was on.
sentences.zh: 电视上正放着电影《公主新娘》（The Princess Bride）。

sentences.en: She was watching it.
sentences.zh: 她正在看。

sentences.en: And just as I walked in the room is that final scene in the movie where Inigo is sitting by the window with a man in black.
sentences.zh: 就在我走进房间时，正好是电影的最后一幕，伊尼戈（Inigo）正和黑衣人坐在窗边。

sentences.en: And the man in black asks Inigo, would he like to be the next Dread Pirate Roberts?
sentences.zh: 黑衣人问伊尼戈，他是否愿意成为下一任恐怖海盗罗伯茨（Dread Pirate Roberts）？

sentences.en: And the Inigo Montoya actor, who was me, said these words, which I did not really know what
sentences.zh: 而饰演伊尼戈·蒙托亚（Inigo Montoya）的演员——也就是我——说了这些话，当时我并不真正明白

sentences.en: they meant, that William Goldman wrote, which I think are the singular greatest words I've ever read.
sentences.zh: 它们意味着什么，那是威廉·戈德曼（William Goldman）写的，我认为这是我读过最独特、最伟大的话。

sentences.en: And those words are, were, and always will be.
sentences.zh: 那些话过去是，现在是，将来也永远是。

sentences.en: You know, I have been in the revenge business so long.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我从事复仇这一行太久了。

sentences.en: Now that it's over, I do not know what to do with the rest of my life.
sentences.zh: 现在一切都结束了，我不知道余生该做些什么。

sentences.en: And I ask Jews all over the world to consider what this man, Benjamin Netanyahu, and his right-wing government is doing to the Jewish people all over the world.
sentences.zh: 我请求全世界的犹太人思考一下，这个人——本雅明·内塔尼亚胡（Benjamin Netanyahu）及其右翼政府——正在对全世界的犹太人民做什么。

sentences.en: They are endangering not only the state of Israel, which I care deeply about and want to exist, but they are endangering the Jewish population all over the world.
sentences.zh: 他们不仅在危及以色列国——我深切关心并希望它存在——他们还在危及全世界的犹太人口。

sentences.en: He is the most dangerous thing, not just since October 7th.
sentences.zh: 他不仅是自10月7日以来最危险的存在。

sentences.en: It is, it has been a deeply troubled situation.
sentences.zh: 这确实是一个极其令人不安的局面。

sentences.en: Um, you are correct.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你说得对。

sentences.en: It was, it was one of, if not the singular most formative event that took place in my younger years.
sentences.zh: 这是我年轻时发生的最具塑造性的事件之一，如果不是唯一的话。

sentences.en: Um, that the truth means everything to me, almost to a fault because I feel that I don't deserve to live.
sentences.zh: 嗯，真相对我来说意味着一切，甚至到了过犹不及的地步，因为我觉得我不配活着。

sentences.en: If I do a take while I'm making a movie with Elmo and my concentration failed while I was talking to Elmo and I'm back in my trailer, literally thinking about calling my therapist
sentences.zh: 如果我在和Elmo拍电影时走神了，没能集中注意力，回到拖车后，我真的会想给我的心理医生打电话，

sentences.en: because I failed Elmo.
sentences.zh: 因为我辜负了Elmo。

sentences.en: Oh, and that's to the degree what, uh, of what I'm dealing with here.
sentences.zh: 哦，这就是我所面对的问题的程度。

sentences.en: And when I didn't tell my father the truth that he had cancer because my mother and his
sentences.zh: 当我没有告诉父亲他患有癌症的真相时，因为我的母亲、他的

sentences.en: two elder sisters and the doctor and everybody who was the grownup to 18 year old Mandy said,
sentences.zh: 两个姐姐、医生，以及所有在18岁的Mandy看来是大人的人都说，

sentences.en: you mustn't tell daddy because he had an earlier accident where he broke his neck and it was very traumatic for him when he was like 17.
sentences.zh: 你不能告诉爸爸，因为他之前出过事故，脖子骨折了，那对他17岁时来说是非常痛苦的经历。

sentences.en: And if you tell him he has cancer, he'll probably take his life.
sentences.zh: 如果你告诉他他得了癌症，他可能会自杀。

sentences.en: So I put myself in the position to do what the grownup said.
sentences.zh: 所以我把自己放在了听从大人们建议的位置上。

sentences.en: And I never got to sit with my father to tell him the truth of his condition.
sentences.zh: 我再也没能坐下来告诉父亲他病情的真相。

sentences.en: And when we lied to him and told him he had hepatitis, my father was not a fucking idiot.
sentences.zh: 当我们对他撒谎说他得了肝炎时，我父亲可不是个该死的白痴。

sentences.en: He knew he didn't have hepatitis in five seconds.
sentences.zh: 他五秒钟就知道自己没得肝炎。

sentences.en: And we never got that moment and you don't get back and I'll never forgive myself for it.
sentences.zh: 我们再也没有那个时刻了，你无法挽回，我永远不会原谅自己。

sentences.en: And the way I deal with it is I try to be truthful to you, to my wife, to my son, to my audience and to the world.
sentences.zh: 我处理这件事的方式就是努力对你、对我的妻子、对我的儿子、对我的观众和对世界保持诚实。

sentences.en: And, and it is, it is not hard.
sentences.zh: 而且，这并不难。

sentences.en: It is not hard to be truthful.
sentences.zh: 保持诚实并不难。

sentences.en: I never, I never heard that about grandpa.
sentences.zh: 我从来没听说过关于爷爷的这件事。

sentences.en: I never heard that you guys told him he had hepatitis.
sentences.zh: 我从来没听说过你们告诉他他得了肝炎。

sentences.en: I didn't know that was part of that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道那是其中的一部分。

sentences.en: I told you a million times, but maybe you didn't.
sentences.zh: 我告诉过你一百万次了，但也许你没听进去。

sentences.en: Maybe I didn't, I don't, I, yeah, yeah, that's exactly what happened.
sentences.zh: 也许吧，我不，我，是的，是的，事情就是那样发生的。

sentences.en: I wish to God I could answer any of your questions without getting so intense.
sentences.zh: 我真希望我能回答你的任何问题而不至于变得如此情绪化。

sentences.en: I don't know how to do it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该怎么做。

sentences.en: I wish I could.
sentences.zh: 我希望我能。

sentences.en: Wait, Gideon, maybe you could help me bring this question home.
sentences.zh: 等等，Gideon，也许你能帮我把这个问题引向深入。

sentences.en: Let me get out the fire extinguisher.
sentences.zh: 让我先把灭火器拿出来。

sentences.en: I mean, the truth, you know.
sentences.zh: 我是说，真相，你知道的。

sentences.en: Is there, is there, no, is there, do you, just in your own memory, is there a moment that you think kind of encapsulates what your family is about?
sentences.zh: 有没有，有没有，不，有没有，你，就你自己的记忆而言，有没有一个时刻你认为它概括了你们家庭的本质？

sentences.en: No, I think we're just as messy and complex and contradictory as like any other family that's trying to get along, trying to understand ourselves and each other.
sentences.zh: 不，我认为我们和其他任何试图相处、试图理解自己和彼此的家庭一样，混乱、复杂且充满矛盾。

sentences.en: And kind of the pathway, I think, towards having more peace and less misunderstanding is like trying to talk to each other about our shit when we have problems with each other.
sentences.zh: 我认为通往更多平静和更少误解的途径，就是当我们彼此之间有问题时，试着谈论我们的烂摊子。

sentences.en: I don't think there's a singular moment.
sentences.zh: 我不认为有什么单一的时刻。

sentences.en: I don't think there's a singular saying.
sentences.zh: 我不认为有什么单一的格言。

sentences.en: I think it's just a big, swirling, beautiful mess.
sentences.zh: 我认为这只是一个巨大的、旋转的、美丽的混乱。

sentences.en: I want to thank all three of you for letting me and our audience sit with you and your various feelings of discomfort and comfort and being a family.
sentences.zh: 我要感谢你们三位，让我和我们的观众能够与你们坐在一起，感受你们在舒适与不适之间作为家庭的各种情绪。

sentences.en: So thank you for taking the time.
sentences.zh: 所以谢谢你们抽出时间。

sentences.en: I really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激。

sentences.en: When's the next question, David?
sentences.zh: 下一个问题是什么时候，David？

sentences.zh: 那么我就要开始收费了。
